findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 揭露 2023、2024、2025 年皆無單一客戶占營收超過 10%。
findings.excerpt: No single customer accounted for more than 10% of our revenue in the years ended December 31, 2023, 2024, or 2025.

findings.claim: 2025、2024 年底無客戶占應收帳款淨額 10% 以上，2023–2025 年無客戶占營收 10% 以上。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 8 Financial Statements
findings.excerpt: For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, no customer accounted for more than 10% of the Company’s revenue. No customer represented 10% or more of accounts receivable, net as of December 31, 2025 and 2024.

findings.claim: 部分最大客戶採「pool of funds」承諾支出模式，不要求特定產品或每期支出金額，收入認列可能不即時反映新增/續約變動。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: our subscription agreements with certain of our largest customers are structured on a "pool of funds" model in which the customer commits to spend at least a specified amount on our products during the subscription period.
International markets represented 51%, 49%, and 48% of our revenue in the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024, and 2023, respectively
